title: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODELの意味がoverrideからdefaultへ変更され、既存設定のsubagent modelが黙って変わる
summary: Claude Code v2.1.251 changed CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL to set the default subagent model rather than override everything, so an agent definition's model: field and an explicit per-spawn model now take precedence. Teams that set the env var to force every subagent onto a cheap model - a common cost-control workaround - silently lose that guarantee on upgrade wherever an agent file pins a model, changing both spend and output quality with no config edit and no error. The same release added PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch hooks that can block, confirm, or annotate a model switch, which is the new supported control point.
proposed_category: 運用・費用・測定・再現性
